items.text: "check for updates" in the install section answers again: you have the newest, or a newer version is ready
"What's new" in the update notice: see what a new version brings before you update
the version number and this version's notes under Version in the index
opening a link like #install on an iPhone no longer leaves the stage black and the buttons dead
the G-code engine is now part of the shared kit, ready to move other things along a toolpath
a link like #install now waits for the launch cover instead of opening under it
the installed app could pair a new page with old files and freeze behind an invisible layer
a shelf opens at its left end, where the tools that work right now are
"send someone straight here" shows in the installed app too
a music-to-mic slider in the capture panel's video mode; the music comes back after recording
links straight to a place in the app: #install, #guide, #sound, #keys, #credits
